name: signalrgb
title: SignalRGB
description: Live PC sensors, lighting effects, headset mic mute and battery, keyboard game mode and CS2 integration for SignalRGB
author: mendyka

commands.name: pc-sensors
commands.title: PC Sensors
commands.description: Live temperatures, fans, load, clocks and power from SignalRGB

commands.name: effects
commands.title: Lighting Effects
commands.description: Browse and apply SignalRGB effects, presets, brightness and layouts

commands.name: toggle-lighting
commands.title: Toggle Lighting
commands.description: Turn SignalRGB lighting on or off

commands.name: next-audio-output
commands.title: Next Audio Output
commands.description: Cycle to the next audio output

commands.name: companion
commands.title: Headset & Companion
commands.description: Headset battery and mic, keyboard game mode, CS2 integration and the companion service

commands.name: companion-service
commands.title: Companion Service
commands.subtitle: SignalRGB
commands.description: Keeps the background helper running (mic mute mirror, battery alert, keyboard game mode, CS2, audio switching). Enable its background refresh once.

preferences.name: micHardwareToWindows
preferences.title: Mic Mute
preferences.label: Headset mute button mutes the Windows microphone
preferences.description: Discord, Teams and other apps then get no microphone signal

preferences.name: micWindowsToHardware
preferences.label: Windows mute also mutes the headset
preferences.description: Mutes at device level, which apps with raw capture can't bypass

preferences.name: batteryAlert
preferences.title: Battery
preferences.label: Play a sound when the battery is low
preferences.description: Checked every minute, confirmed by re-reads before alerting

preferences.name: batteryNotify
preferences.label: Also show a Windows notification
preferences.description: Notification in addition to the sound

preferences.name: batteryThreshold
preferences.title: Battery Alert Below (%)
preferences.description: Alert when the battery is at or below this level

preferences.name: batteryReAlert
preferences.title: Repeat Alert Every (min)
preferences.description: 0 = only once until the headset is charged

preferences.name: gameMode
preferences.title: Keyboard
preferences.label: Hardware game mode while a game runs
preferences.description: Games are detected by the Power Plan extension (its background command must be enabled)

preferences.name: cs2
preferences.title: Counter-Strike 2
preferences.label: Game State Integration for the CS2 Reactive effect
preferences.description: Receiver on port 3000 and HTTPS bridge on 3443, only while cs2.exe runs

commands.name: toggle-mic
commands.title: Toggle Microphone Mute
commands.description: Mute or unmute the Windows microphone (and the headset)

preferences.name: apiUrl
preferences.title: SignalRGB API URL
preferences.description: Local REST API of SignalRGB (lighting, layouts)

preferences.name: webPipeUrl
preferences.title: SignalRGB WebPipe URL
preferences.description: Local WebSocket of SignalRGB that provides the sensor data

preferences.name: companionUrl
preferences.title: Companion Service URL
preferences.description: Address of the companion helper (audio switching); normally unchanged
